adjudication.rationale: In app/jobs/scheduled/poll_feed.rb the feed item body is explicitly entity-decoded via `content = CGI.unescapeHTML(i.content.scrub)` and then imported with `TopicEmbed.import(...)`. `TopicEmbed.import` creates a Post with `cook_method: Post.cook_methods[:raw_html]`, and `Post#cook` returns `raw` directly for `:raw_html`, skipping the normal cooking/sanitization pipeline. The embed view then renders it with `<%= raw post.cooked %>`. This combination means an escaped payload like `<script>...` from the feed will be turned into live `<script>` markup and persisted/rendered unsanitized, enabling XSS.
